title: ArchitectInstall
description: Optional tracked policy for how The Architect is installed in an application repo. Prefer this over creating an app-root .architect/ stamp for non-copy installs.

install_style.description: How the library is linked into this application.

library_root.description: Project-specific path (relative to app root, or absolute) to the Architect checkout. Required when the library is not the workspace root and core/ is not a resolvable link.

write_app_root_stamp.description: When false, install/update scripts and /upgrade-architect must not create .architect/ at the app root. Copy-install may set true.
